content.text: Skip to main content Trump Accounts More In File Individuals Who should file Steps to file your taxes File your tax return Get an extension Amend return Your information Life events Students Employees Parents Military Seniors and retirees Businesses and self-employed Charities and nonprofits International taxpayers Governmental liaisons Federal, state and local governments Indian tribal governments Tax exempt bonds Taxpayer identification numbers (TIN) Trump Accounts give the next generation a jump start on saving The Working Families Tax Cuts allows parents, guardians and other authorized individuals to establish a new type of individual retirement account for their children, called Trump Accounts. The account is for a child who has not turned age 18 before the end of the calendar year in which the election is made and has a valid Social Security number. The account features a pilot program contribution of $1,000 for children born between Jan. 1, 2025, and Dec. 31, 2028, and who are U.S. citizens with a valid Social Security number. Learn more about Trump Accounts and how they work.
